methods.name: Mix Trend Swing + Futures Breakout, half the money each
methods.result: Smoother than either part alone, 2020 to 2026: Sharpe 1.37 vs 1.27 and 1.14, worst drop -43% vs -62% and -44%. Hidden months +21.9%. This is the Combo 50/50 bot.

methods.name: Rebalance the mix back to 50/50 every month
methods.result: A little smoother in testing (Sharpe 1.43, worst drop -38%) but it means moving money between a spot account and a futures account every month. The live bot keeps the halves separate.

methods.name: Weight the parts by risk instead of 50/50
methods.result: Worse than plain 50/50 with the same monthly rebalancing: Sharpe 1.36 vs 1.43, worst drop -42% vs -38%.

methods.name: Add the 1h/15m Trader as a third part
methods.result: Made the mix worse: Sharpe 1.34, worst drop -48%. It moves with Trend Swing (daily correlation 0.68), so it adds risk, not variety.

methods.name: Buy-stop resting at the breakout trigger
methods.result: Entries got 0.19% cheaper, but it caught far more fake breakouts: profit per trade halved (0.24% to 0.12%) and the hidden months went -8.0% instead of +10.3%.

methods.name: Machine-learning filter on the breakout (gradient boosting, retrained each year on past trades only)
methods.result: It skipped trades that later won. Hidden months -1.1% vs +7.8% for taking every trade; 2021 to 2026 +67% vs +104%.

methods.name: Size by volatility: bigger when calm, smaller when wild
methods.result: More profit (hidden +15.4% vs +10.3%) but a deeper worst drop (-48% vs -42%), and it averaged 2x leverage in the hidden months. The gain came from taking more risk, so it was not adopted.

methods.name: Daily trend following that also shorts below the 50-day average
methods.result: Shorting lost money in 6 of 7 years compared with waiting in cash: Sharpe 0.75 vs 1.19 for long-or-cash.

methods.name: 100,000 evolved strategies, each generation better than the last
methods.result: Training scores kept rising, but the final pick made +3.5% in the hidden months vs +10.3% for the original breakout. Estimated chance the search was overfit: 43%.

methods.name: Same breakout on ETH as a robustness check
methods.result: Not run: no ETH price history was reachable from the test machine.

combo.note: Rules and settings were picked on January 2020 to March 2026 only. The hidden months (April 1 to October 16, 2026) were looked at once, at the end. The Combo mixes two bots whose rules were already fixed, so nothing new was tuned to build it. Backtests are compounded from $8,000 with the same fees and fills as the live bots.
